Scarlet & Violet series · MEW

151

Released September 22, 2023 · 207 cards

StandardExpanded

151 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Scarlet & Violet series, released in English on September 22, 2023. Its main set has 165 cards, plus 42 secret rares numbered beyond the set (207 in total). It includes 185 Pokémon, 21 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

102 illustrators worked on 151. Most cards: Mitsuhiro Arita (6), miki kudo (5), Oswaldo KATO (5), Yoriyuki Ikegami (5), GIDORA (4), Shiburingaru (4), Teeziro (4), aky CG Works (3).
